title: Base Power button
description: Square-shouldered 8px buttons in a semibold grotesk: a lime fill with forest text, a forest hairline outline for light bands, and a light hairline outline for photo bands. Colours shift over 0.15s on hover and a trailing chevron nudges right.
notes: ghost follows the foreground colour: use it inside a dark-scoped photo band
lime hover lightens on light bands and deepens slightly over photos (it fades the fill)
name: basepowercompany-button

props.name: href
props.description: where it goes; without it the button is a <button>

props.name: variant
props.description:
lime: the filled lime CTA with forest text · outline: a forest hairline button on light
bands · ghost: a light hairline button for photo bands (follows the foreground colour)

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: an icon after the label (e.g. a chevron or arrow); it nudges right on hover

props.name: block
props.description: stretch to the width of its container (used on phones)

props.name: type
props.description: for a <button>: the form button type
